decision_rule.not_replicated: Any candidate disagreement, invalid neutral scenario, stale output, source-kernel dependency, history-proof failure, or independence-contract violation.
decision_rule.partial: Execution completes but one or more comparison dimensions are unavailable without changing the frozen protocol.
decision_rule.replicated: Every candidate has the same failed-gate set and classification as the source proof, all neutral scenarios validate, committed output equals a fresh isolated execution, all independence checks pass, and Git ancestry proves the fixture corpus predates the implementation.

fixture_corpus.merge_requirement: Merge commit required; squash or rebase would destroy the reachable staged-history evidence.

independence_contract.neutral_fixture_requirement: Fixtures contain scenario parameters only and no expected gate outcomes or proposed foundation.

lifecycle_boundary.acceptance: Not authorized by this replication PR.
lifecycle_boundary.investigator_independence: Not established; external investigator replication remains a nonclaim.
lifecycle_boundary.promotion: Not authorized by this replication PR.
lifecycle_boundary.replication: This protocol can establish implementation-independent clean-room replication inside the repository.

question: Does a clean-room implementation using neutral fixtures independently reproduce the source campaign's candidate gate classifications?
scope: Project FAR v1.0 finite explicit auditable representational architecture
